local_models.name: Qwen3 4B
local_models.blurb: Small and quick, good at following instructions and using tools.

local_models.name: Qwen3 8B
local_models.blurb: A strong all-rounder for chat, writing and tool use.

local_models.name: Qwen3 14B
local_models.blurb: Noticeably smarter than 8B; needs a larger graphics card to be fast.

local_models.name: Qwen3 30B-A3B
local_models.blurb: Mixture-of-experts: large but quick for its size, even partly in memory.

local_models.name: Gemma 3 4B
local_models.blurb: Small model that can also read images.

local_models.name: Gemma 3 12B
local_models.blurb: Good writer that reads images; a tight fit on 8 GB cards.

local_models.name: Gemma 3 27B
local_models.blurb: Google's largest open Gemma 3, with image input.

local_models.name: Llama 3.2 3B
local_models.blurb: Very small and fast; fine for short everyday tasks.

local_models.name: Llama 3.1 8B
local_models.blurb: Widely used 8B model with a long context.

local_models.name: Qwen2.5 Coder 7B
local_models.blurb: Made for code: writing, explaining and fixing it.

local_models.name: Qwen2.5 Coder 14B
local_models.blurb: A stronger coding model for larger graphics cards.

local_models.name: DeepSeek R1 8B
local_models.blurb: Thinks step by step before answering; slower but careful.

local_models.name: gpt-oss 20B
local_models.blurb: OpenAI's open-weight model; mixture-of-experts, so usable partly in memory.

local_models.name: Mistral Small 3.2 24B
local_models.blurb: Capable general model with tools and image input.

local_models.name: Phi-4 mini
local_models.blurb: Compact Microsoft model, good at maths for its size.
